comment: P4.d6 ensureHelpDocsSynced differential spec (v4 6c59b1ca bug 1 + 551f090b's trigger/prune/enqueue). ONE committed help tree (fixtures/help-ensure/help/: aurora.md + brahma-console.md) with the seed varying per scenario, so each scenario isolates exactly one trigger path. The contentHash values are the sha256 of each file's TRIMMED bytes, so a seeded row with that hash is 'unchanged' and the sync must leave it alone — which is what makes 'in-sync' a genuine no-sync and 'deleted' a genuine deleted-direction-only trigger. Each scenario builds its OWN database at $QT_FIXTURE_ENSURE_DIR/qt-ensure-<name>-main.db. P4.D77 (v4 24633026) adds the chunk backfill: 'in-sync' now takes the early-return branch with an EMPTY help_doc_chunks table, so the backfill must slice every existing doc and enqueue a HELP_DOC job for it even though both docs already carry embeddings; 'in-sync-chunked' is the same shape with chunk rows already present, where the one count() query must short-circuit and write nothing. P4.D222 (v4 492771aff, bugs 167+168) REPLACED the gate with the startup reconcile: every scenario now runs the full sync, backfills every section-less doc and enqueues every doc missing its own vector or any section's. The six older scenarios keep their seeds (in-sync-chunked, added-doc, deleted-doc and no-profile MOVED; empty-table and in-sync did not) and six more mirror v4's reconcile vectors as planted real-DB arms; 'calls' selects the multi-call gate arms, and every line records the reconcile's INFO and the gate's WARN counts. A seeded doc's 'hash' may be 'stale' (a contentHash that matches no file).

scenarios.name: empty-table
scenarios.note: The lazy gate that ALWAYS worked: no rows -> sync. The control.

scenarios.name: in-sync
scenarios.note: Every file has a row and every row has a file -> NO divergence -> no sync, no prune. The rows' embeddings are non-null so nothing is owed for the DOCS — but P4.D77's chunk backfill fires here: the chunk table is empty, so both docs are sliced and a HELP_DOC job is enqueued for each (the job is what fills the chunk vectors).

scenarios.name: in-sync-chunked
scenarios.note: P4.D77: identical to in-sync, except help_doc_chunks ALREADY has rows. The backfill's one count() query must short-circuit before slicing anything — no chunk is rewritten (the seeded chunk keeps its sentinel content and its embedding) and NO job is enqueued. This is the 'costs one count query per boot once it has run' arm.

scenarios.name: added-doc
scenarios.note: v4 BUG 1: the table is POPULATED and aurora is unchanged, but brahma-console.md ships with no row. The old gate (existing.length > 0 -> return) left it invisible forever. Diverges via the UNSYNCED direction -> sync -> brahma created -> enqueued (its embedding is null).

scenarios.name: deleted-doc
scenarios.note: The DELETED direction is load-bearing: EVERY file on disk already has a row with a matching hash, so the unsynced direction cannot fire. Only the retired row (no file) can trigger this sync — and without the trigger the prune would be dead code.

scenarios.name: no-profile
scenarios.note: Same divergence as added-doc, but NO embedding profile is configured: the sync still completes and the docs are still listable; only the enqueue backs off (v4's debug-log-and-return).

scenarios.name: edited-page
scenarios.note: P4.D222 (v4 492771aff, help-doc-sync.test.ts:321): aurora.md was EDITED since it was seeded (a stale contentHash) while its doc vector and its one section vector are both present; brahma is in sync and complete. The reconcile's full sync rewrites aurora (update by its own id, re-slice, clear the vector) and queues it alone; brahma is left alone.

scenarios.name: complete
scenarios.note: P4.D222 (:333): both docs in sync, each with its own vector and every section vector ({total:1, embedded:1}) -> 0 incomplete, NOTHING enqueued, no row touched.

scenarios.name: null-doc-vector
scenarios.note: P4.D222 (:373): as complete, but brahma's OWN vector is null while its section is embedded -> brahma alone is incomplete and enqueued.

scenarios.name: partial-sections
scenarios.note: P4.D222 (:386): aurora has TWO section rows, one embedded ({total:2, embedded:1}) -> enqueued, and NOT re-sliced (both seeded chunk ids survive); brahma complete.

scenarios.name: concurrent-then-later
scenarios.note: P4.D222 (:420): an EMPTY table; two ensure calls race, then a third arrives after both settle. The reconcile runs ONCE (one 'Help docs reconciled' line), both docs created once.

scenarios.name: fail-once-then-retry
scenarios.note: P4.D222 (:430), on a REAL database: both docs in sync with vectors but no section rows, and a trigger that aborts every help_doc_chunks INSERT planted for the FIRST call only (renaming the table away is useless in v4, whose getCollection recreates it), so the backfill's replaceForDoc throws: the call resolves with ONE 'reconcile failed' WARN and no section is written. The trigger is dropped; the SECOND call runs a fresh reconcile (the failure was forgotten) and backfills both docs.
